description: This file defines the BugsQuickCreate class for the SuiteCRM platform, extending the QuickCreate class to handle the quick creation form for bug records. It includes a process method that sets up form options and JavaScript for AJAX handling.

classes.name: BugsQuickCreate
classes.description: A class managing the quick creation interface for bug records in SuiteCRM, inheriting from QuickCreate and handling form setup, options, and associated JavaScript.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the quick create form for bugs, setting language strings, options, and JavaScript integration, especially handling AJAX requests.
